latin_text: Therefore it was the Spirit of the Lord, the spirit of love, that was borne upon the deep, that is, upon the angelic intellect (for love follows understanding). Driven and excited by it, the mind of the angel turns toward God. God said 'Be light made,' and light was made in the angel, the light of intelligible forms.
english_translation: Therefore it was the Spirit of the Lord, the spirit of love, that was borne upon the deep, that is, upon the angelic intellect (for love follows understanding). Driven and excited by it, the mind of the angel turns toward God. God said 'Be light made,' and light was made in the angel, the light of intelligible forms.
exegesis:
[VERIFIED] Pico's sophisticated biblical-mystical reading: Genesis 1:2's "Spirit of the Lord borne upon the waters" becomes the spirit of love borne upon the angelic intellect. Love is the motive principle; it excites and drives the angel's mind toward God. God's command "Let light be made" results in the intelligible forms illuminating the angel. [VERIFIED] This reading aligns with Pseudo-Dionysian theology: love (eros) is the principle that moves all things toward their source.

The philosophical function is to show that angelic creation is fundamentally erotic: the angel is constituted by love's movement toward God. This explains why the highest angelic function is seraphic love-union. [INFERRED] Humans ascending participate in this same erotic structure: love precedes and moves intellection.

[VERIFIED] Commento Book II develops Love as the cosmos-animating principle born from the union of Porus-Penia. Oration (O.1.8-O.1.9) emphasizes seraphic love as transformation. Being & Unity grounds it: love is participated divine eros.
notes: HARVESTER passage: H.TE3.C2.4 | Day 1 Genesis as creation of angelic intellection through love
